description: This file defines an interface IQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor for monitoring performance metrics related to a message queue receiver in the Orleans streaming framework. It specifies methods for tracking initialization, read operations, messages received, and shutdown events.

classes.name: IQueueAdapterReceiverMonitor
classes.description: Interface responsible for monitoring receiver performance metrics in Orleans streaming.

methods.name: TrackInitialization
methods.description: Tracks attempts to initialize the receiver, recording success, duration, and exceptions.

methods.name: TrackRead
methods.description: Tracks attempts to read from the partition, noting success, time taken, and exceptions.

methods.name: TrackMessagesReceived
methods.description: Tracks messages received and time taken for successful read operations.

methods.name: TrackShutdown
methods.description: Tracks attempts to shutdown the receiver, recording success, duration, and exceptions.
